entries.stanceLine: Breakouts suspect in both directions today — 118% of a typical day's range is already spent — fresh breakouts have little fuel; favour fades back into the range over chasing.

signals.text: 118% of a typical day's range is already spent — fresh breakouts have little fuel; favour fades back into the range over chasing.
Sterling is at the 100th percentile of its 20-day range and still rising — a persistent FX headwind capping upside breaks (weak GBP is what lifts FTSE).
FTSE is tracking a firmer European tape (Euro Stoxx +0.58%) — the cross-market lean is up.
GBP is a crowded short — a short-squeeze higher in sterling is a latent slap for upside breaks (strong GBP weighs on FTSE).

entries.aiStanceLine: Due to sterling sitting at its 100th percentile (strongest in 20 days), 118% of the 14-day average daily range already consumed, and a crowded GBP short that could squeeze further at any moment, tomorrow's 08:00 ORB breakouts — especially to the upside — will need strong overnight range context and volume confirmation before trusting them.
aiBullets: At 118% of ADR-14 (84.6 pts) already used, the index has statistically overextended its typical daily fuel — any ORB break tomorrow starts from a compacted overnight range, likely tightening the opening range itself and raising false-break risk.

GBP at the 100th percentile of its 20-day range AND a crowded-short positioning read (net short 53,966 contracts) creates a double-edged FX threat: a further squeeze higher in sterling directly undermines any long ORB break on FTSE.

Copper +1.53% and Brent +0.82% both bullish today, but these commodity gains are a today story — if they fade overnight, the miner and energy tailwind that supported 10,805 won't carry forward to support an upside ORB break at 08:00.

The 76.5-point gap up from prior close (10,728.5 to current 10,805) with no ORB high/low yet set means tomorrow's cash open will define the first clean range — watch whether the index opens above or below the prior week low (10,710) for directional context.
